_what: What each codeline IS and what an agent working inside it needs to know that the source does not say. Produced by the codeline-discovery agent during THIS run and rewritten every run — never accumulated, so nothing here is older than the run that wrote it. The engine splits this per codeline into each worktree's .epam/.
_shape: Codeline names are TOP-LEVEL keys, because the engine extracts one with jq '.[$cl]'. Nesting them under another key parses fine and yields nothing for every codeline.

facts.text: Jest is the test runner, but 'npm test' has a pretest hook ('pretest': 'npm run build:config') that first bundles next.config.source.ts into next.config.js with esbuild, and the same build:config step is also required before dev, build and lint.

Node 22.x is required by the engines field, and husky (via the 'prepare' script) plus commitlint with commitlint-config-jira and commitlint-plugin-jira-rules are installed, so commits must follow the Jira-aware commit convention.

Outside the test environment the app throws "Missing required environment variables" unless API_KEY, DELIVERY_TOKEN, ENVIRONMENT and CONTENTSTACK_BRANCH are set, so any preview work depends on these Contentstack credentials being present.
facts.source: src/services/contentstack.ts: "throw new Error(\"Missing required environment variables\")" when !API_KEY || !DELIVERY_TOKEN || !ENVIRONMENT || !CONTENTSTACK_BRANCH

facts.text: A dedicated preview-environment CI/CD pipeline already exists that the live-preview work can build on.
